name: const-language
description: Plain prose in governed documents, checked by Vale after every write and in a scan. The check holds a Flesch–Kincaid grade ceiling and a words-per-sentence limit. It reports idioms and formal phrases plain language avoids, formal words with a plain replacement, and passive voice. Every threshold and level is a dial. A departure is declared in the dials file and never marked in the document. Plus a skill that applies the rules while writing and reads a finding.
